title: channels__list_channels — output
description: Output schema for the channels__list_channels MCP tool. Returns all channels with at least one subscriber or at least one message in the backing store's retention window (default: last 24 hours). The mandatory '_sox_protocol' block carries version negotiation metadata — clients MUST read it on first call and fail-fast if their supported version range does not intersect with the server's. Normative reference: spec/protocol.md and docs/decisions/version-negotiation-mechanism.md.

channels.description: List of discoverable channels. An empty array means no channels are currently active.

subscriber_count.description: Number of agents currently subscribed to this channel.

_sox_protocol.description: Mandatory version negotiation block. MUST be present on every list_channels response. Clients MUST read this on first call and fail-fast if their supported version range does not intersect with the server's. If a client skips list_channels, it assumes the latest server version at its own risk. See docs/decisions/version-negotiation-mechanism.md.

server_version.description: The protocol version this server implements (semver-like, e.g. '1.0'). Semver-formatted: MAJOR.MINOR.

supported_versions.description: All protocol versions this server can speak. Clients check for intersection with their own supported range. An empty intersection MUST cause the client to refuse to operate.

min_client_version.description: The minimum client protocol version this server will accept. Clients below this version MUST NOT proceed.

metadata.description: Pipeline observability metadata. Always present in dispatched responses; populated by the middleware Pipeline base. Includes pipeline_trace (per-plugin execution trace) and correlation_id (request correlation). Tools and clients MAY ignore metadata; backwards-compatible.

pipeline_trace.description: Per-plugin execution trace. Each entry: {plugin_id, kind, started_at, finished_at, verdict, error_code?, correlation_id}. Verdict ∈ {passed, rejected, errored, skipped}.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation identifier. Echoed from MiddlewareContext.correlation_id (frozen field). UUID4 hex if not provided in input.
